name: Sakashita Matsuri
source:
2nd year high school student.
The protagonist's friend that has known her since she was a first year.
A maiden who adores love stories, but she doesn't really care for guys much.
The ace of the volleyball club, she's adored by all the underclassman girls because of her fresh personality, it worries her a bit though.
